native_prefill.diagnosis: Mini KDALayer.dt_bias and the official model parameter are both one-dimensional. The pinned SDK FlashInferKDAPrefillKernel.extend itself reshapes dt_bias into [heads,128], giving stride0=128. The all-T1 grouped decode route subsequently calls dyn(dt_bias,0), which requires vector stride0=1. Flattening the caller parameter cannot avoid this internal reshape. The failure occurs in the direct official call before a complete same-ABI adapter qualification.
native_prefill.diagnosis_scope: Log stack and pinned source establish this ABI boundary; no successful repair, candidate acceptance or full-model impact is established. A separate new ABI candidate is under investigation.
